com.datastax.dse.driver.api.core.metadata.schema

Interface DseRelationMetadata

  • All Superinterfaces:
    Describable, RelationMetadata
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    DseGraphTableMetadata, DseTableMetadata, DseViewMetadata

    public interface DseRelationMetadata
extends RelationMetadata
    Specialized table or materialized view metadata for DSE.

    This type exists only for future extensibility; currently, it is identical to RelationMetadata.

    Note that all returned ColumnMetadata can be cast to DseColumnMetadata.
